title: adaptive_sf.py: Redundant isinstance check - both branches identical
description: Line 85: 'snr = int(snr_ema) if isinstance(snr_ema, int) else int(snr_ema)' - both branches produce the same result (int(snr_ema)). The conditional serves no purpose. This may indicate the author intended different behavior (e.g., truncation vs rounding) but implemented it incorrectly.
